title: Simply Enhanced
description: This modpack enhances the vanilla experience with many QOL mods.
body:
Simply Enhanced is a moderatly heavy modpack, streamlined improvement of the vanilla Minecraft experience. The pack focuses on polishing the game’s visuals, performance, and quality-of-life features—all without changing the core mechanics that make Minecraft feel like Minecraft. It’s perfect for players who want the game to run smoother, look cleaner, and feel more modern, while still playing exactly like vanilla.

Includes [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential), making it easy for playing with friends.

**Modpack has a pre-applied config file with settings tweaked in a way that made sense to me and for a clean look. However, you can still change them to your liking.**

**Key Features**
  - Subtle Visual Improvements: Cleaner UI elements, refined animations, improved particles, 
    and small aesthetic touches that enhance the game without straying from the original style.
  - Vanilla Gameplay Intact: No progression changes, no overhauls, no new systems—just a better 
    version of the game you already know.
  - Includes stability mods, performance boosts, and efficiency tweaks designed to reduce '
    stutter, and improve FPS
  - Thoughtfully Picked Mods: Every mod is selected for a purpose. Expect smoother menus, 
    improved tooltips, dynamic lighting, cleaner textures, and small QoL changes.

Important Information
1. For world gen, make sure you add the two datapacks in the "datapacks" folder to your world, the generation will be much better.
2. If you don't like the world generation and want the regular one, disable "Lithosphere" and "William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld"
